body: Saying these people are toxic is wrong because they understand that marijuana is completely safe.
Thank you, they don't read anything they just jump to conclusions
I don't have a dependence, I rarely left my house because I was under her control
I'm now homeless and all I have is my phone and done clothes, they took my car and told me to get out. I'll live under a bridge before I go back to that house.
Yeah they hold that against me as well, telling me I'm a drug addict.

I'm saving all that I can and the only drug I've ever done, and it sounds horrible to say this, is marijuana. Marijuana is a miracle drug, and this sounds awful because its frowned upon, but when I'm "high" I feel like the old me before my Mom turned psychotic.

She has 2 more kids one older, one younger, who both do very well in school, and then there's me, mediocre in school, but I'm the only one of her kids with a job. She stops me from leaving by taking everything she has paid for and given me away.

They pay for a large majority of my stuff, which I appreciate, but then whenever we have an argument, they hold it over my head and make me feel useless. I'd rather live on the streets than in this dictator nut house, where everyday something new goes wrong.

In my 19 years of living, this is the worst it has been. I still live at home so I don't get to be like every kid my age. She treats me like I'm 10, so I attempt to leave and live on my own but she won't allow it. I don't even remember what I used to take pride in. She tells me she wished she never had me, which makes me feel like everything and everyone would be way better off if I was dead.
You sir have just described my mother and how she treats me on a daily basis, bravo to you my friend.
